CustomField.description: Set only by LeadDisqualifyAction_CC (Lead UI pilot Disqualify action) in the save that disqualifies the Lead. Disqualification_Stage_Validation_CC uses it, with the Lead_UI_Rework_Access_CC permission, to allow Identify to Disqualified for a named contact through that action only. Not user-editable; not on any layout.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when the Lead was disqualified with the pilot Disqualify action.
CustomField.label: Disqualified by Pilot Action
